text_blocks.snippet: Castleman disease symptoms vary depending on the type (unicentric or multicentric) and whether it's associated with HIV or HHV-8. Common symptoms include enlarged lymph nodes, fever, night sweats, fatigue, and unintentional weight loss. More severe symptoms can include flu-like illness, enlarged spleen or liver, fluid accumulation, and even kidney dysfunction or neuropathy.
